reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Aggressively attacks creatures that come near.

attack_routine.name: charging_gore
attack_routine.notes: Requires enough distance to commit to a charge.

attack_effect.to_hit_rule: +4 to attack throw against man-sized or smaller opponents.

attack_effect.trigger: Enough distance between triceratops and target.

mobility_rules.rule: Can charge to improve its gore attack.

habitat.rule: Lives in grassy sub-tropical and temperate environments.

behavior_rules.rule: Attacks nearby creatures aggressively despite being herbivorous.

population_rules.rule: Gang leader champion: AC5, 3 HD, 16 hp, +2 damage from strength.
Warband leader sub-chieftain: AC6, 4 HD, 20 hp, +2 damage rolls.
Lair or warren leader chieftain: AC7, 6 HD, 28 hp, +3 damage rolls.
As long as the chieftain lives, troglodytes gain +1 to morale rolls.
Female troglodytes fight as hobgoblins, and only to defend eggs.
Warren has 33% chance of a shaman and 25% chance of a witch doctor.
Shaman is statistically equivalent to a sub-chieftain and has Clerical abilities of level 1d4.
Witch doctor is statistically equivalent to a champion and has Mage abilities of level 1d2.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Malicious and warlike; attempts to slay creatures crossing its path.

attack_routine.name: weapon_attack
attack_routine.notes: Favored weapons are stone axes, clubs, and great barbed darts.

attack_effect.to_hit_rule: Treat as javelin with +3 to attack throws.

ability.name: camouflage
ability.effect: Characters encountering troglodytes have a -2 penalty to surprise rolls.

ability.name: stench
ability.trigger: Humans or demi-humans come near a troglodyte.
ability.effect: Victim suffers -2 to attack throws.

social_structure.rule: Organized into gangs, warbands, lairs, and warrens with champions, sub-chieftains, and chieftains.

behavior_rules.rule: Uses environmental blending like a chameleon.

population_rules.rule: Champion: AC6, 7+3 HD, 51 hp.
Chieftain: AC8, 10+6 HD, 63 hp, +2 damage with natural attacks.
As long as the chieftain lives, trolls gain +1 to morale rolls.
Females fight as ogres.
Young fight as orcs.
Village sub-chieftain and bodyguards: AC7, 8+3 HD, 45 hp, +2 damage with natural attacks.
Village has 50% chance of a shaman and 25% chance of a witch doctor.
Shaman is statistically equivalent to a sub-chieftain with Clerical abilities of level 1d4.
Witch doctor is statistically equivalent to a champion with Mage abilities of level 1d2.

special_defense.name: regeneration
special_defense.effect: Regenerates 3 hp each round unless damage was caused by fire or acid.

ability.name: regeneration
ability.effect: Regenerates 3 hp each round unless damaged by fire or acid.
ability.exception: Cannot be permanently destroyed except by fire or acid.

ability.name: reattach_limb
ability.trigger: Loss of limb or body part.
ability.effect: Severed parts crawl or squirm back to the body and reattach instantly if held to the stump.

ability.name: return_from_zero_hit_points
ability.effect: Continues regenerating and stands to fight again when regenerated to 1 or more hp.
ability.exception: Fire or acid can permanently destroy it.

behavior_rules.rule: Tends to lurk in dungeons, caverns, ruins, and swamps.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Hunts any creature that moves, but generally ignores prey smaller than a dwarf.

behavior_rules.rule: Targets moving creatures, usually excluding prey smaller than dwarves.

reaction_or_pursuit_behavior.rule: Only lawful, virtuous maidens may approach unicorns.

mobility_rules.rule: Can carry up to 30 stone (300 lb) at full movement.
Can carry up to 60 stone (600 lb) at half movement.

ability.name: cure_light_wounds
ability.effect: Can cast cure light wounds.

ability.name: dimension_door_transport
ability.effect: Can transport itself and its rider as dimension door up to 360'.

social_structure.rule: Encountered in grace, blessing, or sanctum groupings.

behavior_rules.rule: Shy around creatures not meeting its approach requirement.

population_rules.rule: Must take refuge in a coffin or other sanctum during daylight hours.
Must slumber on soil from its own grave once per month to maintain vitality of powers.

attack_routine.name: touch_attack
attack_routine.notes: Any other touch also carries energy drain.

ability.name: gaseous_form
ability.effect: May take gaseous form at will.

ability.name: shapechange
ability.effect: May shapechange at will into either a dire wolf or a giant bat.

ability.name: summon_allies
ability.effect: Can summon 1d10 bat swarms or rat swarms when underground, or 3d6 wolves or 2d4 dire wolves when above ground.

ability.name: repelled_by_objects
ability.trigger: Lawful holy symbol, mirror, or garlic presented with confidence.
ability.effect: Draws back.
ability.notes: Garlic causes cringing for 1d4 rounds. Holy symbol or mirror forces the vampire to maneuver so the item does not impede progress or attack.
ability.exception: A lawful holy symbol affects the vampire regardless of ethos in life.

ability.name: holy_water
ability.effect: Holy water inflicts 1d6+1 damage.

ability.name: zero_hit_points_state
ability.effect: Not destroyed; forced into gaseous form.

ability.name: reformation
ability.trigger: Rests in coffin for 8 hours while gaseous.
ability.effect: Reforms with full hit points.
ability.exception: If all coffins are broken, cannot reform until a minion builds a new coffin.

ability.name: create_spawn
ability.trigger: Human or humanoid is drained of all life energy by a vampire.
ability.effect: Victim returns as a vampire after 3 days.
ability.notes: Spawn is enslaved to the creator until the master is killed, then becomes free-willed.

social_structure.rule: Uses sanctums and coffins as daytime refuges.

procedure.name: true_destruction

steps.step: Immersion in running water kills the vampire in 1 turn.
Sunlight exposure forces a saving throw versus Death each round; failure turns the vampire to dust.
A stake through the heart plus decapitation destroys the vampire.

procedure.follow_up: If staked without decapitation, the vampire only appears dead and revives if the stake is removed.

behavior_rules.rule: Often trained to hunt giant vermin.
Temperamental and may turn on handlers.

save.on_success: ill and bedridden for 30 days; not fatal

limitations.limitation: Spell cure disease cures the infection.

behavior_rules.rule: Omnivorous scavenger thriving on human trash.

ability.name: echolocation
ability.effect: Can perceive up to 60' by echolocation.
ability.limitation: Silence 15' radius can block this form of vision.

ability.name: deafened_or_blinded_state

ability.name: speed

ability.name: infravision

ability.name: keen_smell

ability.effect: Victim becomes a wraith in 24 hours.

attack_effect.trigger: Hits a creature smaller than itself with both talons.
attack_effect.follow_up: Grabbed creatures of man size or less can be carried off.

attack_routine.name: contact_effect
attack_routine.notes: Yellow mold does not move or attack.

attack_effect.effect: Destroys leather and wood on contact.

attack_effect.trigger: 50% probability whenever yellow mold is contacted.

ability.name: fire_damage_interaction

ability.name: sunlight_dormancy
ability.effect: Sunlight renders yellow mold dormant.

confidence_notes.note: Troll stat block formatting is damaged in the uploaded file. I interpreted the merged text as treasure type "O (per gang)" and XP "680".
Wight stat block formatting is damaged. I reconstructed dungeon encounter, wilderness encounter, alignment, movement, and armor class from the merged table row text.
Yellow mold stat block is truncated and merged. I kept only the fields explicitly visible in the uploaded text and omitted absent armor class, hit dice, save, morale, treasure type, and XP.
Giant weasel prose ends mid-sentence after "These burrowing creatures live in". No further habitat or rule text is available in the uploaded file.
Wyvern prose cuts off after "If eggs or young are". Any further rule concerning eggs or young is missing from the uploaded file and was not inferred.
Monster_type normalization for troll, unicorn, wyvern, and yellow mold uses template categories rather than explicit source labels.
